test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank.**

In order to keep ______ I jog for 45 minutes daily.
solution: The correct answer is "fit." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word** "fit"** means strong and in good physical health (especially because of exercise). (हृष्‍ट-पुष्‍ट और सुस्‍वस्‍थ विशेषतः व्‍यायाम के कारण) • **Example**:* Swimming is a good way to keep **fit**__.* • Here, **"fit"** indicates maintaining physical fitness or health through regular jogging. • So, the correct answer is Option 2. ​ Correct sentence: *In order to keep __**fit**__ I jog for 45 minutes daily. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Feet: **the lowest part of the body, at the end of the leg, on which a person or animal stands. (पैर, पाँव) • **Feat: **something you do that shows great strength, skill or courage. (शक्ति और कुशलता या साहस से पूर्ण कार्य; उल्‍लेखनीय उपलब्धि) • **Fitt: **Incorrect spelling. 205:Ta7b, The correct answer is: **stingy**
